landing.meta_title: Babbby — Daily Baby Activity Ideas for Ages 0–6
landing.meta_description: Babbby picks up to six play ideas a day for your child's age, from 342 activities for ages 0–6. Filter by what's at home. No ads, no subscription.

hero.title: What should we play today? Babbby already has a plan.
hero.description: Every day, Babbby picks up to six activities for your child's age in months, balanced across eight areas of development. Most take ten minutes or less.
hero.note: Free for 14 days, then one purchase unlocks it for good.
hero.phone_alt: Babbby's Today screen for a 12 to 18 month old: three activities to do and one already done, with the first being checked off.

features.title: Ideas that fit your child and your home
features.subtitle: Babbby matches every activity to your child's age and to what you have on hand, then keeps count of what you've done together.

age.title: Matched to their age
age.desc: Seven stages from newborn to six. As your child grows, the daily plan grows with them.

materials.title: Play with what's at home
materials.desc: Mark the materials you have, from crayons to cardboard boxes, and the library shows what you can start now. 99 activities need nothing at all.

photos.title: Keep the moment
photos.desc: Add up to three photos to each finished activity. Every week and month, Babbby gathers them into a short review.

children.title: A plan for each child
children.desc: Add every child with their birthday. Each one gets a daily plan and stats of their own.

privacy.title: Stays on your phone
privacy.desc: No account and no ads. Your child's name, plans and photos are stored only on your device.

stats.title: See where the days went
stats.desc: Count finished activities by week, by month or all time, and see which of the eight areas you've played most.

home.tagline: No shopping list, no lesson plan. Just ten minutes and whatever is already at home.

steps.title: How it works
steps.subtitle: Set it up once. After that, open it whenever you're ready to play.

items.title: Tell Babbby about your child
items.text: A name and a birthday are all it needs to match activities to their age.

items.title: Open Today
items.text: Up to six activities are waiting, each with short steps and a tip. Swap any of them for another from the library.

items.title: Check them off
items.text: Tap to mark one done and add a photo if you like. Your week adds up in Stats and in a weekly review.

closing.title: Try every feature free for 14 days
closing.text: Download Babbby, add your child, and today's plan is ready. If it earns a place in your routine, one purchase keeps it for good. No subscription.

privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.meta_description: How Babbby handles your data: what is collected, how it is stored, and your choices.
privacy_policy.intro: This privacy policy applies to the Babbby app ("Application") for iPhone and iPad, created by Alu Studio ("Service Provider"). This service is intended for use "AS IS". By using the Application, you agree to the collection and use of information as described in this policy.

info_collection.title: Information Collection and Use
info_collection.desc: The Application may collect certain information automatically when you download and use it, through integrated third-party services. This information may include:
items: Your device's Internet Protocol address (IP address)
Device type, operating system version, and unique device identifiers
Usage data such as app feature interactions, session duration, and screens visited
info_collection.no_ads: The Application does not use advertising services and does not collect advertising identifiers (IDFA).

local_storage.title: Local Data Storage
local_storage.desc: Everything you create in the Application, including your children's profiles (name, birth date and an optional photo), activity plans, completion records, notes, activity photos and statistics, is stored only on your device. None of it is sent to Alu Studio or any third party. Like other app data, it can be included in the device backups you make with iCloud or a computer, according to your backup settings. The Application uses the camera or your photo library only when you choose to add a photo, and only the photos you pick are copied into it. The one item kept outside the Application is the start date of your free trial, which is stored in the iOS Keychain so that reinstalling does not restart the trial; it contains nothing but that date.

iap.title: In-App Purchases
iap.desc: The Application offers one optional in-app purchase, the Lifetime unlock, through Apple's StoreKit. All payment processing is handled entirely by Apple. Alu Studio does not collect, store, or have access to any payment information, credit card details, or Apple ID credentials.

activity_disclaimer.title: Activity Recommendations
activity_disclaimer.desc: Activity recommendations provided by the Application are generated algorithmically for inspiration purposes only. They do not constitute medical, educational, psychological, or child-development advice. Parents and guardians are solely responsible for evaluating the suitability of any activity for their child.

third_party.title: Third-Party Services
third_party.desc: The Application uses the following third-party services, each with their own privacy policies governing how they handle data:

data_retention.title: Data Retention
data_retention.desc: Activity data, photos and app settings are stored locally on your device and are never transmitted to our servers. Data collected by third-party services (Firebase Analytics, Firebase Crashlytics) is retained according to their respective data retention policies. Uninstalling the Application permanently deletes its data from your device. The trial start date stays in the iOS Keychain after uninstalling.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.desc: The Application is a tool designed for parents and guardians to plan activities for their children (ages 0–6). It is not intended for direct use by children. We do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from children under 13. Children's profile information (name, birth date and optional photo) and activity photos are stored only on the device and never sent to Alu Studio or any third party. If you believe a child has provided personal information to us, please contact us at alustudio14@gmail.com.

rights.title: Your Rights and Choices
rights.desc: Depending on your location, you may have certain rights regarding your personal data:
gdpr_items: Right to access your personal data
Right to rectify inaccurate personal data
Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten")
Right to restrict or object to data processing
rights.ccpa_desc: You have the right to know what personal information is collected, request deletion of your personal information, and opt out of the sale of your personal information. We do not sell your personal information.
opt_out_items: iOS: Go to Settings → Privacy & Security → Analytics & Improvements to manage analytics data sharing
Uninstall: You can stop all data collection by uninstalling the Application

security.title: Security
security.desc: We value the security of your information. All user data is stored locally on your device and protected by iOS's built-in security measures. However, no method of electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

changes.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.desc: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date. We encourage you to review this page periodically. Continued use of the Application after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.meta_title: Babbby FAQ — Daily Baby Activities App
faq.meta_description: Answers to common questions about Babbby: supported ages, pricing, how activities are recommended, progress records, and privacy.
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions parents ask most about Babbby's daily activities, age matching, and privacy.
faq.contact_prompt: Didn't find your answer? Reach out to us:

what_is_babbby.title: What is Babbby?
what_is_babbby.answer: Babbby — Daily Baby Activities is an iPhone and iPad app that gives parents of children ages 0–6 a ready-made daily activity plan, so there's no need to figure out what to do with your child each day. It includes a library of 342 activities across 8 categories, matched automatically to your child's age, with the option to filter by materials you already have at home and track completed activities over time.

what_ages.title: What ages is Babbby designed for?
what_ages.answer: Babbby is designed for children ages 0 to 6. Its 340+ built-in activities are automatically matched to your child's age, spanning categories such as gross motor, fine motor, language, and sensory development.

is_babbby_free.title: Is Babbby free?
is_babbby_free.answer: Babbby is free to download, and every feature is unlocked for the first 14 days. After the trial, a single purchase keeps everything unlocked for good; there is no subscription and there are no ads. Without it you can still browse Today, the library, stats and past reviews, but adding or completing activities and taking photos need the unlock.

does_it_need_an_account.title: Does Babbby require an account or sign-up?
does_it_need_an_account.answer: No. Babbby requires no account and no sign-up — you can start using it immediately after download. Children's profiles, activity logs, and progress data are stored exclusively on your device in a local database and are never transmitted to a server.

how_are_activities_recommended.title: How does Babbby recommend activities?
how_are_activities_recommended.answer: Babbby automatically matches activities from its 340+ activity library to your child's age, and you can filter further by the materials you already have on hand — such as crayons, cardboard, or blocks — to see only activities you can start right away. Recommendations are generated algorithmically for inspiration only; parents and guardians decide what suits their child.

can_it_track_milestones.title: Can Babbby keep a record of my child's progress?
can_it_track_milestones.answer: Yes, Babbby tracks completed activities, shows a breakdown by category, and displays daily trends so you can look back at every step. This tracking data stays on your device, and it reflects activity-completion history rather than a formal developmental assessment from a pediatrician.

is_my_data_private.title: What data does Babbby collect, and is my child's data private?
is_my_data_private.answer: All user-created content in Babbby — including children's profiles, activity logs, completion records, and statistics — is stored exclusively on your device using a local database and is never transmitted to Alu Studio's servers or any third party. The app shows no ads and does not collect advertising identifiers (IDFA); it uses Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics only for anonymous usage and crash data.
bullets: Children's profile data (name, birth date) never leaves the device and is permanently deleted if you uninstall the app
No ads and no advertising-identifier (IDFA) tracking
EU/EEA users have GDPR rights; California users have CCPA rights, and Alu Studio does not sell personal information
You can limit analytics via iOS Settings → Privacy & Security → Analytics & Improvements

what_platforms.title: What platforms is Babbby available on?
what_platforms.answer: Babbby is available for iPhone and iPad on the App Store. It is free to download, with every feature free for the first 14 days.
